card.title: 8. FALLSCHIRMJÄGER
card.flavorText: The Fallschirmjager's were the paratroopers of the German Luftwaffe before and during WWII. They were the first paratroopers conducting the first airborne infantry assaults in history, but throughout the war they mainly fought on the ground as elite infantry rather than airborne units. They were called the "green devils" by the Allies and were known as fierce and resilient opponents. The 8th Fallschirmjager Regiment was attached to the 3rd Parachute Division of the Luftwaffe, which was formed in 1943. The regiment fought with its division in Normandy and in the Arnhem area before participating in the Battle of the Hurtgen Forest in Germany. They surrendered to the Americans in Rhur in April 1945.
